Analysis of Push Notifications for Bus Operators

The dataset analysis reveals the following key insights regarding push notifications sent to bus operators:

1. Dataset Summary

  • Total Events: 14,952
  • Total Users: 381
  • Event Types: 109
  • Date Range: November 27, 2025 to February 22, 2026

2. Push Notification Metrics

  • Sent Notifications: 0
  • Delivered Notifications: 0
  • Delivery Rate: 0%
  • Click Rate: 0%

Analysis Findings

Based on the gathered data, we can draw the following conclusions:

a) DELIVERY PERFORMANCE

The delivery rate of push notifications is currently at 0%, which is significantly below the acceptable threshold of 60%. This indicates that no notifications have been successfully delivered to users, suggesting potential issues with the notification system or that no notifications were sent at all.

b) ENGAGEMENT DEPTH

Since there were no notifications sent or delivered, the engagement depth, defined as the percentage of unique operators who click on the notifications, cannot be assessed. The click rate is also at 0%, indicating a complete lack of engagement through this channel.

c) OPERATIONAL IMPACT

Due to the absence of sent and delivered notifications, it is impossible to analyze the correlation between push engagement and overall operator active users. Typically, higher push engagement is expected to correlate with increased platform stickiness and user retention, but without any data on notifications, this relationship cannot be evaluated.

In summary, immediate attention is required to address the issues surrounding push notification delivery and engagement to leverage this channel effectively for enhancing operator interactions on the platform.
